description: Look up Demon Slayer data using the free, keyless Demon Slayer API: page through the characters and the breathing and combat styles, search either collection by name, and fetch any single record by id. No account or API key required. Disclaimer: this is an independent integration with the community-run Demon Slayer API (demonslayer-api.com).
